description: This PHP source file defines an abstract test case class 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase' used for integration testing of API endpoints within the OrangeHRM project. It contains methods for setting up fixtures, loading test cases, mocking API endpoints and dependencies, and validating test results, aimed at verifying the behavior of API endpoints in an enterprise HRM system.

classes.name: EndpointIntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending EndpointTestCase, providing utility methods for integration testing of API endpoints, including fixture setup, mock creation, validation, and dependency injection for tests.

methods.name: populateFixtures
methods.description: Loads test data fixtures into the test environment, with optional directory path and cache reset controls.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads and returns a set of test cases from specified fixture files, organizing parameters for API testing.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMock
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock object for a given API endpoint class, configured with specific request parameters.

methods.name: assertValidTestCase
methods.description: Executes validation and assertions for a specific API operation using a supplied test case and mock API.

methods.name: assertServicesInitialized
methods.description: Verifies that all required services and factories have been initialized as per the test case configuration.

methods.name: registerServices
methods.description: Registers services and factories within the dependency injection container based on the test case specifications.

methods.name: getMockAuthUser
methods.description: Creates a mock user object representing an authenticated user, configured with details from test case parameters.

methods.name: registerMockDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Overrides the DateTimeHelperService to return a fixed 'now' timestamp for consistent testing.
